title: Adaptive Cost Safeguard: RBAC-led Safe Apply & Rollback for Batch/Cache Recommendations
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Add a security- and compliance-first control plane for automated batching/caching recommendations so that auto-apply and rollback actions meet RBAC, attestation, and audit requirements. This ticket implements a layered enforcement model: role-based approvals for different change classes, cryptographic attestation for applied configs, an immutable audit ledger surfaced in Console, and automated rollback workflows that produce signed forensic records. The goal is to enable safe auto-application of cost-saving config deltas (batch size, prefix cache policies, kv-cache TTLs) for low-risk workloads while requiring human approval and stricter controls for high-risk/tenant-impact changes. Deliverables include API endpoints, Console UI controls, workflow orchestration, audit log schema, and integration with KMS and SIEM for downstream compliance ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC: Implement three new roles: CostAdmin, CostApprover, CostViewer with scoped permissions (apply, approve, view).
Approval flows: Auto-apply allowed only for low-risk changes; medium/high-risk require CostApprover explicit sign-off in Console or API.
Attestation: Each applied change must be signed with a KMS-backed key; signatures stored with the changelog entry.
Rollback: Rollbacks produce an immutable rollback record including who initiated, which signature attests to the rollback, and the pre-change snapshot.
Audit visibility: Console exposes per-customer and per-model change timelines; all entries are exportable to SIEM in JSONL format.
Policy tests: End-to-end tests that simulate race conditions (concurrent applies + autoscaler) and ensure no silent config drift.
implementation_notes: AuthZ: Extend existing policy engine to accept risk-class metadata from the recommender.
Workflow: Use durable tasks (Celery/Temporal) to orchestrate multi-step apply -> sign -> verify -> notify paths.
KMS: Use HSM-backed KMS key for signing attestation blobs; rotate keys per policy.
Storage: Append-only change ledger stored in encrypted object store with content-addressed IDs for tamper evidence.
Console: Add 'Pending Approvals' card under Cost Recommendations and an audit timeline component for a single change.
detailed_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): API + minimal Console controls, basic RBAC roles, attach signature metadata to change events, smoke tests. Phase 2 (2 sprints): Full approval workflows, SIEM export, KMS integration, automated rollback orchestration and signed rollback artifacts. Phase 3 (1 sprint): Hardening, e2e chaos tests, compliance review and docs for SOC2/ISO evidence.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Auto-apply could introduce regressions affecting latency/SLOs. Mitigation: restrict auto-apply to traffic-isolated pools and require canary test for any >10% throughput change.
Risk: Audit logs could be incomplete during failover. Mitigation: buffer signed events locally and flush to immutable store on restore; add monitoring alerts for flush failures.
Risk: Key compromise. Mitigation: key usage policies, limited access, and emergency revoke + replayable event signatures for incident investigation.
testing_strategy: Unit: policy engine permission matrix and simulation harness for risk classification.
Integration: apply -> sign -> verify -> rollback flows with mocked KMS and SIEM endpoints.
E2E: Canary rollout to staging with traffic replay and SLO checks, including chaos tests for partial failures.
Security: Red-team review of authz paths and signature verification; pen-test for tamper attempts on ledger.
